prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical studio fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman against a clean white and pale-pink backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, bright joyful smile, natural skin texture, clean studio makeup, and glossy pink nails. She wears the supplied shiny pink metallic one-piece fashion outfit with wide shoulder straps and a structured scoop neckline.
composition_elements: Medium-full vertical portrait, slightly bent forward with weight on one leg, one hand under chin in a playful gesture and the other resting on the upper thigh.
One knee gently bent with feet grounded or minimally visible; clean white studio with pale-pink side panel.
Preserve metallic fabric reflections, ponytail, smile, hand placement, and playful editorial mood.
